description.name: Entry
description.text: Ten single attacks (0.71 each), grants [Attach Earth], [Heavy Rank Boost] and [Heavy Charge Booster] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Heavy Rank Boost
description.text: Heavy abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5

description.name: Heavy Charge Booster
description.text: Increases Heavy Charge level by 1 when the Heavy Charge level is increased
